_comment: LEVEL 3 (feature): bulk CSV import for an entity — multipart upload, header-row validation, per-row error reporting, partial import (valid rows inserted, bad rows reported). Completes the admin import/export pair with feature-export.
name: feature-import
description: Bulk CSV import endpoint: multipart upload, header validation, per-row errors, partial import (valid rows inserted).

variables.name: resource_name
variables.description: Singular entity name, e.g. 'Product' (must match feature-crud's)

notes: Pairs with feature-export (import/export round-trip: the export's CSV columns are the import's header). Frontend: send with comp-http-client — const fd = new FormData(); fd.append('file', csvFile); await api('/api/{{ resource_name|lower }}s/import', {method:'POST', body: fd}); (comp-http-client skips JSON encoding for FormData). Response: {created, errors:[{row,message}], total_rows}. TODO: register the router; add admin/auth protection when needed.
